topography.project_purpose: Beanstalk is a decentralized algorithmic stablecoin protocol that issues the BEAN stablecoin, using a credit-based model and a decentralized price oracle to maintain its peg. It also includes the Basin Exchange, a decentralized exchange for swapping stablecoins and other assets.
topography.relationship_narrative: Beanstalk relies on Oracles for price data to maintain the BEAN peg and facilitate Basin Exchange swaps. Non-Bean Assets provide the external tokens used in Basin Exchange pools, while BeaNFTs serve as ecosystem incentives, all governed by shared multisig infrastructure.
